title: graceful-exit-strategy-for-legacy-model-weights
creator: Martin Chen
description: Define and deliver an operationally-safe, developer-friendly deprecation workflow for older model weights and variants that integrates version pinning, performance-profile compatibility checks, and automated migration guidance. The goal is to minimize customer disruption while clearing long-tail model variants that increase maintenance overhead and test surface.
background: We maintain multiple historical model weights and lightweight variants for compatibility. These long-tail versions add test, observability, and SLO overhead. Past retirements revealed gaps: inconsistent notices, missing pinning guidance in SDKs, and customers surprised by latency regressions after automatic fallbacks. This ticket defines a composable workflow that product, eng, and DX teams can run for future sunsets.
goals: Provide a repeatable 4-stage deprecation workflow (Intention -> Compatibility Window -> Migration Assistance -> Sunset)
Automate detection of customers using deprecated pins via telemetry and surface migration paths in Console and SDK warnings
Publish machine-readable migration guides tied to performance profiles so customers can evaluate alternatives programmatically
Reduce post-sunset incidents by 80% relative to the last three retirements
proposed_workflow_steps: Stage 0 - Intention: internal banner + create migration ticket and compatibility checklist; announce roadmap to key accounts
Stage 1 - Compatibility Window (60 days): publish performance-compatibility report comparing candidate replacements; add console badge on affected routes; enable opt-in migration helper in Console

Stage 2 - Migration Assistance (30 days): automated SDK warnings on pinned versions with suggested pin command; provide CLI tool to run consumer test prompts against replacement model and generate report

Stage 3 - Sunset (14 days notice): final deprecation email + disable new create surface for deprecated variant; keep read-only audit logs for 180 days; automatic fallback configured per customer policy
communication_templates: 90-day intent email template for accounts (with performance delta table and recommended pin)
Console banner copy for compatibility window with link to migration checklist
SDK warning message with both human and machine parsable hint (X-Model-Deprecation header)
migration_artifacts_needed: Performance-compatibility CSV for each deprecated variant (latency, p99, cost-per-token, quality delta on eval set)
Pull-requestable migration playbook in docs repo with code snippets and common prompt adjustments
CLI/SDK 'check-compatibility' command that runs a sample prompt set and emits a pass/fail + suggested pin
console_work_items: Add deprecation banners and link to guide on model detail page
Show live telemetry of customers with pinned deprecated versions
Expose one-click 'generate migration report' card for account admins
sdk_work_items: Emit structured deprecation warning in responses (header + structured JSON) for pinned requests
Expose client method to query recommended replacement and migration steps
Ship patch that surfaces performance profiles for replacement models (non-breaking)
acceptance_criteria: Runbook created and reviewed by Eng + Security + DX
Console banners and telemetry view implemented behind feature flag and validated against staging traffic
CLI/SDK warnings land in a patch release and tests exercise pinning warnings
Two pilot customers complete migration using the published playbook and report 'low friction' via survey
success_metrics: % of affected customers migrated before sunset (target >= 75%)
Post-sunset incidents caused by automatic fallback (target < 5 incidents across customers)
Average time-to-migrate per customer (target < 10 business days for active accounts)
Number of manual support tickets created during migration (target < 10)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Replacement models have subtle quality regressions for niche prompts -> Mitigation: publish per-customer prompt-set comparisons and provide temporary dual-write option
Risk: Customers pin to exact model hash and cannot accept replacement -> Mitigation: provide SDK helper to rewrite pin to compatible family with thorough warning
Risk: Automated telemetry misses on-prem/private deployments -> Mitigation: include a privacy-preserving opt-in reporting mechanism and offline migration checklist
timeline_and_milestones: Draft runbook (2w) -> Console/SDK flags implemented in staging (4w) -> Pilot migration with two accounts (2w) -> Public compatibility window (60d) -> Sunset (14d final notice)
